name: Iconic Destinations
description: A premium collection of iconic cities, landmarks, heritage sites and natural destinations. Each design uses its own colour palette so the artwork can preserve the character and atmosphere of the place.
description_en: A premium collection of iconic cities, landmarks, heritage sites and natural destinations. Each design uses its own colour palette so the artwork can preserve the character and atmosphere of the place.
description_es: Colección premium de ciudades, monumentos, lugares históricos y destinos naturales emblemáticos. Cada diseño utiliza su propia paleta para conservar el carácter y la atmósfera de cada lugar.

canvas_rules.detail_policy: Prefer one strong focal landmark and readable silhouettes over micro-detail.

generation.purpose: Reusable page-1 lifestyle/ambient image for the Iconic Destinations cross-stitch collection.
generation.frame_requirement: Leave the craft display area empty so the final vector pattern can be inserted by the renderer.
generation.post_generation_measurement: Record exact source dimensions and usable area geometry after approval.

source_policy.rule: Each D0001-D0060 product must read its own extracted 100x120 PNG directly. Mosaic, board, crop, and .pixz sources are forbidden.
